metric_definitions.src_text: All physical lines in src/*.py, including comments/docstrings/blanks.
metric_definitions.src_sloc: Python token-bearing physical lines excluding comments, blank lines and AST docstrings.
metric_definitions.code_sloc: Substantive source+tests+scripts+notebook-code lines from the supplied program; excludes generated results, prose, notebook output and future additions.
metric_definitions.importance: Source SLOC × disclosed role weight: 5 core outcome/validity/inference/shared foundations, 4 representation/evaluation correctness, 3 diagnostics, 2 rendering/CLI, 0 empty marker. Subjective allocation proxy, not measured effort.

canonical_rules.old_evidence: Edited snapshot evidence stays under evidence/source_snapshot; its empty ledger and reduced records are imported exactly. Earlier unedited source ZIP is never a fallback.
canonical_rules.source: aztokenizertransfer_FINAL_v3_edited.zip; SHA-256 116fb3dd4a9411b6f32f1554688e2ca8a45afd6b5fb2dba88249042a5a9d8989; original source ZIP is not an input to these plans
canonical_rules.evidence_provenance: results_full.zip and report_evidence_pack.zip are earlier as-run evidence; keep their bytes and existing paths. Their ledgers/disclosures describe earlier history and do not certify an untouched test set in the edited source.
canonical_rules.ledger_roles: evidence/source_snapshot/results/test_evaluation_ledger.jsonl is the empty edited snapshot ledger; results/test_evaluation_ledger.jsonl is the separately supplied as-run ledger. Do not substitute either for the other or infer lifetime access from either alone.
